one_liner: Entry-level Air Force PALACE Acquire intern helping run base prevention programs on suicide, sexual assault, family violence and alcohol misuse, with a path to GS-11.
fit_summary: Daniel's people skills, public-facing ease and emergency-management consulting background map well to the relationship-building, planning and readiness parts of this role. The hard parts are the behavioral or social science basic requirement and the one year of GS-5-level specialized experience in client interviewing, needs assessment and counseling, which IEM consulting work may not clearly show. A social science degree, such as political science, could help if it counts as "related," but HR decides that from transcripts.
eligibility: Basic requirement: a behavioral or social science degree (or related discipline), or a qualifying combination of education and experience, or four years of experience showing equivalent knowledge.

GS-7 level: 1 year of graduate study, a bachelor's degree with Superior Academic Achievement, or 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-5 (client interviewing, needs assessment, counseling on work/life, crisis or readiness issues).
Hiring paths include the public, so no federal status is required. The Education section also describes a Recent Graduates option for degrees awarded within 2 years.
Transcripts are required if you qualify using education. Degree audits are not accepted.
You must be able to obtain a Secret clearance, and you will serve a 1-year probationary or 2-year trial period.
keywords: assess and measure organizations' trends, concerns, and needs
communicate effectively both orally and in writing
strategy: Frame your IEM work around the preparedness and readiness duties you actually performed, such as needs assessments, stakeholder or community interviews, recovery assistance and planning, and use the posting's own language.

List each job with start and end dates (month/year) and hours per week, and include any volunteer or part-time work involving counseling, crisis support, outreach or helping people navigate services. The posting explicitly credits these.

Upload transcripts for any degree you hold. If your degree is political science or public policy, show the social and behavioral science coursework you took, such as sociology, psychology or research methods.

Prepare for HireVue: practice recorded STAR answers and cognitive-style assessments, since the evaluation competencies include Communication, Problem Solving, Planning and Prioritization, and Conscientiousness.
Keep the resume to two pages and lead with your most relevant experience. Answer the questionnaire honestly at the level your resume can prove.
The announcement is open continuously until 2027-09-30, but apply early, because rolling announcements often pull candidates in batches.
resume_bullets: Conducted [number] interviews and needs assessments with [government clients/community members] to identify [preparedness/recovery] concerns and recommend [referral options/resources].
Supported planning and implementation of [preparedness/recovery program] for [client], tracking [data/trends] and drafting [plans/briefings] for [audience] ([hours] hrs/week).
Built working relationships with [officials/program representatives] across [number] agencies, coordinating [outreach/training events] for [number] participants.
interview_questions: Tell us about a time you interviewed someone who was reluctant to admit a problem existed. How did you identify their needs and what referral or next step did you suggest?
How would you use data to identify prevention priorities on an installation?
Describe how you have built trust with leadership and with front-line individuals at the same time.
Why are you interested in prevention work, and what would you hope to learn in a 2–3 year training plan?
watch_outs: Qualification risk: without a behavioral or social science degree or documented counseling and needs-assessment experience, you may be screened out at the basic requirement.
Location is listed as "Multiple Locations" with no telework or remote option, so you may have to relocate to an Air Force installation.
You must be able to obtain a Secret clearance, and the probationary period requires written certification to keep the job.
Some Education-section language refers to the "DHA Recent Graduates Program," which appears inconsistent with this Air Force posting. Confirm which hiring path you are applying under.
